description: This file defines the DataPipelineClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Data Pipeline service. It includes method annotations for operations such as activating, creating, and deleting pipelines, as well as managing pipeline definitions and tags.

classes.name: DataPipelineClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Data Pipeline service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a Data Pipeline.

methods.name: describeObjects
methods.description: Describes objects within the Data Pipeline.

methods.name: queryObjects
methods.description: Queries objects within the Data Pipeline.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Removes tags from a Data Pipeline.

methods.name: reportTaskRunnerHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends heartbeat signals for task runners.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the pipeline.

methods.name: setTaskStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a task.
